name: performance-sensitive
description: Performance-critical work — hard budgets, SLAs, frame rates, latency targets
when: Change targets measurable performance: latency SLO, memory budget, GPU frame time, throughput

roles.whenNeeded: the budget fix changes a seam, contract, or dependency direction

notes: Lead coordinates. Architect is conditional: pull in only when the budget fix changes a seam, contract, or dependency direction (a within-seam tune needs no architect). Review strategy: Claim-Verify for defined budgets, Adversarial when bottleneck is novel.
